Messages are data files under `src/i18n/` — see `docs/I18N.md` ("Adding your language") for how to add or change one. Fixing a few strings yourself in a pull request is welcome too; this issue is for anything you would rather discuss first.

## Language

<!-- e.g. Portuguese (pt), French (fr) -->

## What this is about

- [ ] A message that is wrong, unclear or uses unusual terms
- [ ] A language I need that isn't available
- [ ] I'd like to translate a language
- [ ] I can review a language (I speak it natively and work in accessibility): add me to the translation reviewers in `docs/I18N.md`
